senses.gloss: פַּזֵּים (cmp. פָּזַז) [to leap,] to speak or sing in one’s turn (corresp. to h. עָנָה).
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 3:2">Targ. Job III, 2</cite> <he>ופ׳ איוב</he> (v. Perles Beitr. z. Gesch. d. hebr. u. aram. Studien, Munich 1884, p. 67 sq.).

<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 15:21">Targ. Ex. XV, 21</cite> <he>ופַזִּימַת</he> Ar. Haḳḳ. Ms. Regensb. (v. Perles l. c.).—[In liturgy <he>פִּזְמוֹן</he> a poem with a refrain for congregational response.]
